# EOXS

> EOXS delivers cloud-based ERP solutions and AI automation technology specifically designed for the steel distribution and flat-rolled steel industry.

EOXS specializes in enterprise resource planning software tailored for steel service centers, combining inventory management, transaction processing, and artificial intelligence to optimize steel distribution operations. The platform serves flat-rolled steel businesses with tools for automated forecasting, pricing, logistics, and after-sales support.
